narrative.intro: DDB Chicago obligated $303M in federal contracts in FY2026 to date. DDB Chicago has 11 awards this fiscal year and an average award size of $27.6M. DDB Chicago obligations are down 22.4% year over year. DDB Chicago obligations have varied across recent fiscal years: FY21 was $348M, FY22 was $363M, FY23 was $596M, FY24 was $399M, and FY25 was $391M. The current-year total is partial, representing fiscal year to date activity rather than a full-year total. The average award size indicates a small number of relatively large contracts rather than many small buys. The year-over-year decline of down 22.4% contrasts with the peak in FY23 at $596M and with more moderate totals in FY24 and FY25. Contractors and subcontractors assessing DDB Chicago for teaming or pursuit should plan around the concentration implied by 11 awards and the $27.6M average award size, and should note that FY2026 activity is not a full-year measure.
